title: BT41011: Transport Phenomena In Bioprocess
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Unified approach to physical rate processes associated with momentum, mass and
energy transport. Differential and integral treatment on the conservation laws.
Momentum, mass and energy transfer in laminar and turbulent flow with
applications to interphase. Macroscopic balance. Molecular transport
properties.
